heading: Wednesday, November 19, 2025
topLine: 3 model releases: Meta SAM 3 and SAM 3D, xAI Grok 4.1 Fast and OpenAI GPT-5.1-Codex-Max.

items.headline: Meta releases SAM 3 and SAM 3D
items.summary: SAM 3 detects, segments and tracks objects in images and video from text and visual prompts, and SAM 3D is a pair of models that reconstruct 3D objects and human bodies from a single image. Meta released weights or checkpoints, inference code and evaluation datasets, and made both available in its Segment Anything Playground.

items.headline: xAI releases Grok 4.1 Fast and Agent Tools API
items.summary: Grok 4.1 Fast is a tool-calling model with a 2M-token context window for agentic API use, launched with an Agent Tools API for server-side search, code execution and MCP. xAI reports a 100% score on tau2-bench Telecom and half the hallucination rate of Grok 4 Fast.

items.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-5.1-Codex-Max
items.summary: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max is an agentic coding model that uses compaction to work across multiple context windows on long-running tasks, and is OpenAI's first model trained to work in Windows environments. It became the default in Codex, with API access later.
